title: Slight odor, but it didn't last long.
text: Slight odor, but it didn't last long.. The mattress is very comfortable, sleeps well and fit the Long twin frame perfectly. It did have a slight chemical smell, but it didn't take long to go away.

product_metadata.title: Nod by Tuft & Needle 6-Inch King Mattress, Adaptive Foam Bed in a Box, Responsive and Supportive, CertiPUR-US, 100-Night Sleep Trial, 10-Year Limited Warranty,Grey
features: LIGHTWEIGHT COMFORT - Created using our proprietary T&N Adaptive foam, the Nod 6” combines a support layer and a pressure-relieving top layer, in a lightweight package.

GREAT SLEEP MADE ACCESSIBLE: By focusing on comfort and support, the vital components of a great night’s sleep, we were able to make a remarkably comfortable mattress at a price that is accessible to everyone.

CERTIFIED: We go the extra mile to get our mattresses Greenguard Gold and CertiPUR-US certified. This means our beds are held to the highest of standards and are third party certified to be free of harmful chemicals, substances, and materials.
NO RISK: Our mattress has a hassle-free 10-year limited warranty you can actually use (no gimmicks) and a 100-Night Sleep Trial. If you have any questions at all, do not hesitate to reach out!
NOTE: Please allow up to 72 hours for the mattress to fully expand and for any potential odor to dissipate.
description: Nod makes great sleep accessible to all without compromising quality or comfort. The nod mattress is designed with two layers of open cell Tuft & Needle Adaptive foam that maximize breathability, support, and pressure relief. Our Adaptive foam is designed to sleep cooler and be more supportive than outdated materials such as memory foam and latex. The nod is backed by a 100-night sleep trial so you can take the time you need to decide if it’s the right mattress for you.

details.Care instructions: Do not remove cover that came on the mattress, Spot clean soiled area with a mild detergent and water such as dawn soap
